caption: Kar. 11. Stela (Kar. Cem., Pl. 18, No. 7102)
reading: wosi : soreyi : qo wos?m?ẖ?e(2)yeqowi : metewiqb?e ted(3)ḫli tedḫelowi : slmsa(4)d?iẖli : yerikeli : yeri(5)kelowi : ssorleb : yetmde(6)lowi : slmsleb : yetmdelo?wi (7)metelẖse : simltelowi : ato(8)mẖe : psoẖekete : atmẖe : psḫr(9)kete : ḫmlol : pẖolkete : (10)mlolowi
notes: Line 1: after soreyi a short group (slash-tick-hooked 3) read qo?, then the name. Line 2: first sign ')' read m?; '·S' read t (dot before the sign) though the S is large; two H-shaped signs read d?; a sign drawn '(//' read se. Line 3: the word written 'S///' + r + i + k twice: read ye-r-i-k (y then e, as the strokes stand right of the S); the first copy ends with a bold 8-like sign read e?. Line 4-5: two parallel name + yetmde-lowi groups; the left 'yetmdelowi' has b-like w with a trailing stroke, o uncertain. Line 7: first benediction 'ato mẖe', the 3 after m read ẖ. Line 10: an S-shaped sign between the two o's read l?. 3s, Ʒ-shapes: s by default, ẖ when the 3 has a long tail, m when ')' or J-shaped; all 3-shapes in names are uncertain (s?). '/3' with a plain 3 read s+o (as in soreyi); '//Ʒ' with a bold hooked Ʒ read q+o (qowi). Σ-topped or ξ-shaped signs with long tails read p in the benediction words after 'ato/at mḫe', k elsewhere; both uncertain (p vs k). Small hooked 5/9-shaped sign read l, larger S read e.
check_notes: Names table A-C, Indexes A-C and formulae A, B, C all placed. The type shows this copy's 4-like small sign is l (slms, simltelowi), its ')' is m, its '/ϥ' is te in pẖolkete. Kept the copy's soreyi against Index C 'sori'; kept ssorleb against the Index A ditto 'ssorlito leb'. Index A/B type read ẖ in metelẖse, Index C typed metelmse; kept ẖ.
